problems.

distributed systems and enables rapid feature deployment

documentation, and adherence to coding best practices

Python and web application development

databases, including complex query design and optimization

● Hands-on experience with web frameworks such as Django, FastAPI, or Flask

workflows

modeling

● Understanding of software testing methodologies including unit testing,

integration testing, and test-driven development

practices

● Knowledge of microservices architecture and distributed systems design

● Understanding of front-end technologies (JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3) for better

full-stack collaboration

● Knowledge of security best practices and compliance requirements (SOC2, data

protection standards)

Personal Qualities

● Strong problem-solving abilities with analytical thinking and attention to detail

● Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration with technical and

non-technical stakeholders

● Self-motivated and proactive approach to identifying and solving technical

challenges

● Continuous learning mindset with passion for staying current with emerging

technologies and best practices

● Team player mentality with experience in agile development environments

What We Offer

Professional Growth

● Passionate team environment with leadership colleagues who share the vision of

delivering innovative construction project management solutions

● Accelerated learning opportunities across role-relevant areas including advanced

backend architectures, cloud technologies, and system design

● Mentorship and career development programs to support your professional growth

and technical expertise

● Conference attendance and training budget to stay current with industry trends

and best practices

Work Environment & Culture

● Modern development tools and technologies with investment in developer

productivity and experience

● Collaborative, inclusive workplace that values diverse perspectives and

encourages innovation

decisions and product direction

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Company Description Ace Keystone Consultants (AK Consultants) is a deep-tech innovation R&D firm based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Founded in 2025, the company focuses on empowering organizations and professionals to achieve their goals through cutting-edge research, strategic advisory, and transformative solutions. AK Consultants supports clients across sectors by driving innovation, helping them navigate complex challenges, and unlocking new growth opportunities. Core service areas include innovation consulting, research and development for emerging technologies, and customized solutions for sustainable growth.

Job Description

We are seeking a technically rigorous Machine Learning Engineer to join our R&D and product development team, working on signal, sensor and imaging intelligence. You will convert engineering and product requirements into AI/ML system architectures, data specifications, algorithms, flowcharts and production-grade software, with full ownership of the machine learning lifecycle from problem formulation to validated, deployable models.

We are looking for an engineer who can design and build models and algorithms from first principles, with the mathematical and implementation depth to develop solutions that do not depend on third-party AI APIs or frontier models where those are not the right fit, rather than primarily adapting existing online code, repositories or pre-built solutions.

**Technology Focus Areas:**

This role spans the following core technology areas across our R&D programmes:

• Time-series and signal analysis of multi-sensor data (motion, pressure, ultrasound), including filtering, spectral and time-frequency analysis, and feature extraction.

• Anomaly detection and predictive modelling on noisy, non-stationary real-world data, from early detection to risk prediction and decision support.

• Computer vision and image analysis (ultrasound, CT, thermal): segmentation, detection, classification and quantitative analysis.

• Multi-sensor data fusion, physics-informed simulation and synthetic data generation where real-world data is scarce.

• Efficient, edge-deployable models engineered for resource-constrained devices under strict latency, memory and power budgets.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Translate engineering and product requirements into system architectures, data flows, algorithm specifications and technical flowcharts.

• Independently develop clean, modular and maintainable Python code for AI/ML applications, including custom algorithms and models where off-the-shelf or API-based options are unsuitable.

• Design, train, validate and optimise machine learning and deep learning models, and build end-to-end pipelines covering preprocessing, feature engineering, training, inference, validation and decision logic.

• Specify the data required to solve a given ML problem (variables, sampling frequency, resolution, volume, diversity, labels, metadata and quality criteria), and work closely with the Data Team to define collection, preparation, labelling and validation protocols.

• Make evidence-based build-vs-buy decisions: third-party AI API, fine-tuning an existing model, or a custom model, based on accuracy, cost, data privacy, latency and offline requirements.

• Design, build and integrate APIs to serve models and connect them with products and external services.

• Optimise models and software for accuracy, throughput, latency, memory footprint and computational efficiency.

• Develop proof-of-concept solutions for open R&D problems, and benchmark alternative algorithms and architectures through structured experiments.

• Independently test, debug and troubleshoot ML models and software, and document architectures, algorithms, data requirements, model performance and design decisions.

**Required Skills & Experience:**

• Strong programming skills in Python, with demonstrated ability to develop applications independently, from problem definition to working code.

• Strong algorithmic thinking, mathematical reasoning (linear algebra, probability and statistics, optimisation) and engineering problem-solving skills.

• Experience in Machine Learning and Deep Learning, with a sound understanding of model internals (loss functions, gradients, regularisation, generalisation), deep enough to build or adapt a model rather than rely only on third-party AI APIs.

• Hands-on experience with Scikit-learn, PyTorch and/or TensorFlow, and proficiency with NumPy, Pandas and data preprocessing.

• Strong understanding of APIs: designing, building and consuming REST APIs, including authentication, error handling, rate limits and versioning.

• Ability to design system architectures, flowcharts, algorithms and data-processing pipelines.

• Rigorous approach to model training, validation, benchmarking and performance evaluation, including metrics selection, cross-validation and error analysis.

• Experience with time-series or signal data (e.g. filtering, FFT/wavelet analysis, sensor noise handling), or with medical or biological image analysis.

• Experience with software debugging, testing, version control and Git.

**Beneficial:**

• Awareness of sensors, computing platforms and hardware constraints such as CPU/GPU/NPU capability, RAM, storage, bandwidth and inference latency. The role does not involve hardware design or integration.

• Model optimisation techniques such as profiling, quantisation, pruning and knowledge distillation.

• Computer vision, OpenCV, edge AI, MATLAB/Simulink, Docker or cloud deployment.

• Experience with biomedical or other sensitive data, and awareness of handling it responsibly.

**What We Are Looking For:**

An engineer who can be given a new technical problem and independently work through:

Problem → Data Requirements → System Architecture → Flowchart → Algorithm → Code → ML Model → Validation → Optimisation

The candidate should be able to clearly explain to the Data Team what data is required and why. The use of established libraries, frameworks, APIs and documentation is expected. However, candidates should be able to understand, explain and modify the algorithms and code they implement, rather than depending on solutions they cannot independently develop or troubleshoot.

**Qualifications:**

• B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech/M.Sc. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Electronics, ECE, Mathematics, or a related discipline.

• 2 - 5 years of relevant hands-on experience in ML/AI software development is preferred.

• Demonstrable experience in developing at least one ML/AI solution from problem definition through model development and implementation.

**Selection Process:**

Shortlisted candidates will undertake an in-person practical technical assessment in Coimbatore, covering:

• Problem analysis and system architecture

• Flowchart and algorithm development

• Identification of ML data requirements

• Independent Python coding

• API design and integration

• ML model development, evaluation, debugging and optimisation

• Communication of data requirements to the Data Team

Use of AI tools is acceptable. The assessment will focus on your own programming, algorithmic thinking and problem-solving ability, so you must be able to explain, justify and modify every part of your solution.

A GitHub profile or portfolio is mandatory. Applications without one will not be considered.

**About Eci Solutions**
ECI Solutions builds cloud-based business management and ERP software for small and mid-sized companies in manufacturing, distribution, building and construction, and field service. Our Business Systems organisation runs the Salesforce platform that our global sales, revenue and customer support teams depend on every day — a single connected org that sits at the centre of our quote-to-cash and customer-support operations and integrates with our ERP, billing, CPQ, data and telephony systems.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
ECI’s customer support organisation runs on Service Cloud. Thousands of cases a month flow through it, across multiple products, regions, support tiers and channels, and it is the system our customers judge us by when something goes wrong.
  
  
We are looking for a senior developer to own the engineering behind that platform — case lifecycle, routing, entitlements, knowledge, channels, telephony and the integrations that connect support to the rest of the business — and to build the next generation of it with Agentforce and Einstein.
  
  
This is a hands-on individual contributor role on a small team. You will work directly with support operations leaders, not through three layers of translation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Service Cloud Engineering**

* Design, build and maintain the case lifecycle: record types, case assignment, escalation, queues, milestones, entitlements and SLA enforcement.
* Build and tune Omni-Channel routing — skills-based routing, capacity models, presence, and queue design — against real support workload patterns.
* Develop Lightning Web Components and Apex to streamline the agent console: custom quick actions, guided flows, related-record panels, and macros that remove clicks from high-volume work.
* Configure and extend intake channels: Email-to-Case, Web-to-Case, Experience Cloud customer portal, chat/messaging, and in-product case creation.
* Build and maintain Knowledge: article types, approval and publishing workflows, data categories, article recommendations, and attach-to-case behaviour.
* Implement CSAT/NPS survey capture and feed the results back into reporting and coaching workflows.

**AI and Automation**

* Build Agentforce service agents for case deflection, summarisation, and assisted resolution, including topic and action design, grounding in Knowledge and Data Cloud, and testing against real case history.
* Implement Einstein capabilities such as case classification, article recommendations, reply recommendations, and work summaries.
* Design the guardrails: escalation to a human, confidence thresholds, audit logging, and measurement of whether the automation actually helped.
* Automate repetitive support operations work with Flow, Apex, and scheduled jobs.

**Integrations**

* Integrate Service Cloud with telephony/CTI (Amazon Connect, Genesys, Five9 or similar), engineering issue trackers (Jira or Azure DevOps), ERP and entitlement sources, and the data warehouse.
* Build and maintain API-based integrations using REST/SOAP, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and middleware such as MuleSoft.
* Own error handling, retry logic, and reconciliation so that failed integrations are visible and recoverable rather than silent.

**Quality and Operations**

* Write unit tests with meaningful assertions and maintain coverage well above the platform minimum.
* Participate in code review both as author and reviewer, and mentor junior developers on the team.
* Support production incidents affecting the support organisation, perform root-cause analysis, and prevent recurrence.
* Deploy through a Git-based CI/CD pipeline and keep metadata under source control.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience: 5–9 years in software development, including at least 4 years building on Salesforce with substantial Service Cloud work.
* Service Cloud depth: Hands-on with case management, Omni-Channel routing, entitlements and milestones, Knowledge, the Service Console, and at least two intake channels in production.
* Apex: Strong Apex — trigger frameworks, asynchronous processing, bulkification, governor limits, and SOQL optimisation for large data volumes.
* LWC: Production Lightning Web Component development with modern JavaScript, including Apex wiring, events, and console-specific APIs.
* Declarative craft: Strong Flow skills and good judgement about when a Flow is the right answer and when it is not.
* Integration: Experience building API integrations with authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT, Named Credentials) and robust error handling.
* DevOps: Salesforce DX, Git, and deployment through a CI/CD pipeline.
* Communication: Comfortable gathering requirements directly from support managers and agents, and pushing back with a better option when the requested solution is the wrong one.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Production experience with Agentforce, Einstein for Service, or Data Cloud.
* CTI/telephony integration experience.
* Salesforce Field Service experience.
* Experience Cloud customer or partner portal development.
* Experience supporting an internal support organisation in a SaaS or software company.
* Familiarity with support metrics — first response time, time to resolution, deflection rate, CSAT — and how platform design moves them.

**CERTIFICATIONS**

* Required: Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I.
* Strongly preferred: Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant.
* Valued: Platform Developer II, Agentforce Specialist, Agentforce Service Consultant, JavaScript Developer I, or Platform Administrator.

**What Success Looks Like**

* By 60 days: You understand our case lifecycle and routing model end to end and have shipped your first production changes.
* By 6 months: You own a meaningful area of the Service Cloud platform outright, have delivered at least one measurable improvement to agent efficiency or customer response time, and support operations comes to you directly.
* By 12 months: Agentforce or Einstein capability you built is live, measured, and demonstrably deflecting or accelerating case work.

**What We Offer**

* A single, high-impact internal Salesforce org — you will see the business result of what you ship, not just a ticket closing.
* Real investment in Agentforce, Data Cloud and AI-assisted automation, with budget and executive sponsorship behind it.
* Funded Salesforce certifications, Trailhead time, and a defined technical career path.
* Health insurance, provident fund, and leave policy per ECI India policy.

*ECI Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of gender, religion, caste, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic.*
**How To Apply**
Please apply with your CV and, where possible, your Trailhead profile link. Candidates should be able to reliably commute to or relocate to Hyderabad.
